facts.fact: The APD's deliberation 005/2025 of 30 July 2025 is issued under Loi n° 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 and requires controllers using cloud services abroad to seek APD authorisation under the law's prior-formalities regimes.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Deliberation 005/2025 (amended text published 30 April 2026) sets minimum conditions for foreign cloud use under Loi 2017-020: prior authorisation, a transfer clause, data return and permanent deletion; it cites decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on the APD's composition and operation.
The deliberation was adopted by the APD under its president with seven named members present, and cites decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on the authority's composition and operation.
facts.system: Autorité de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (APD)

facts.fact: The APD adopted deliberation 005/2025 on 30 July 2025, binding public and private controllers using foreign cloud services to obtain its authorisation; the amended text was published 30 April 2026.
